notes: The answer settles this as Obby & Platformer: the climb is a simple challenge players can fail, which is a skill course the player paces themselves, and the genre-wide P6 for physics-legal spacing applies. The rooftop jumping with other players is the payoff at the end rather than a second genre, so it lands on winner-zone and secondary stays empty. Shape is course-tower because the answer puts the route on the outside of a modern high-rise, so ledges and balconies wrap the facade and sit directly above one another — that overhang is a feature genuinely present, so the P2 is required rather than assumed, and the P6 on top of it is not overridable. Decided without a user: obstacle-timing was dropped from the preset because nothing suggests vanishing platforms, obstacle-jump was added for the stepped and wrap-around gaps a facade climb needs, and I assumed no checkpoints so a fall restarts the climb, which matches a tower obby and the answer's framing of a single fail-able ascent.
